sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的Dealbook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: For weeks after mass protests and international pressure failed to unseat Venezuelan President
sentences.zh: 在数周的大规模抗议和国际压力未能推翻委内瑞拉总统

sentences.en: Nicolas Maduro, it became clear that it would take defections from within his own regime to remove him from power.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯·马杜罗之后，显而易见，只有他政权内部的倒戈才能将他赶下台。

sentences.en: Now, secret documents leaked to my colleague Nick Casey suggest that people around Maduro are starting to turn on him.
sentences.zh: 现在，泄露给我同事尼克·凯西的秘密文件表明，马杜罗身边的人开始背叛他了。

sentences.en: It's Friday, May 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月3日，星期五。

sentences.en: Nick, what happened at the beginning of this week in Venezuela?
sentences.zh: 尼克，本周初委内瑞拉发生了什么？

sentences.en: It's around sunrise, Tuesday morning, and Venezuelans wake up to this video, which has suddenly appeared.
sentences.zh: 那是周二早上日出时分，委内瑞拉人醒来后看到了这段突然出现的视频。

sentences.en: And it's Juan Guaido.
sentences.zh: 视频里是胡安·瓜伊多。

sentences.en: Guaido's the leader of the National
sentences.zh: 瓜伊多是国民

sentences.en: Assembly.
sentences.zh: 议会的领导人。

sentences.en: They're very used to seeing him.
sentences.zh: 他们对他非常熟悉。

sentences.en: He's been saying that he is the legitimate president of Venezuela for months and that he's going to topple Nicolas Maduro.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，他一直声称自己是委内瑞拉的合法总统，并誓言要推翻尼古拉斯·马杜罗。

sentences.en: But he hasn't been able to do that so far.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，他还没能做到这一点。

sentences.en: Except in this video, suddenly things look different.
sentences.zh: 但在这一段视频中，情况突然看起来不同了。

sentences.en: He's standing on a military base.
sentences.zh: 他站在一个军事基地里。

sentences.en: He's got National Guardsmen standing behind him.
sentences.zh: 他身后站着国民警卫队的士兵。

sentences.en: And he's saying the moment has come.
sentences.zh: 他说时刻已经到了。

sentences.en: This is it.
sentences.zh: 就是现在。

sentences.en: Everybody is going to start to rebel right now.
sentences.zh: 每个人现在都要开始反抗了。

sentences.en: These men behind me are on my side.
sentences.zh: 我身后的这些人站在我这一边。

sentences.en: And it's only a matter of time till the rest of the country is going to be as well.
sentences.zh: 剩下的国家加入我们只是时间问题。

sentences.en: Come out to the streets.
sentences.zh: 走上街头吧。

sentences.en: Come out and join us.
sentences.zh: 出来加入我们。

sentences.en: The moment is at hand.
sentences.zh: 时机已到。

sentences.en: And then when you look behind him in the video, there's another man that everybody in Venezuela recognizes but hasn't seen in a while.
sentences.zh: 当你观察视频中他身后的人时，还有另一个人，委内瑞拉人都认识他，但已经有一阵子没见到了。

sentences.en: It's Leopoldo Lopez, who is a political prisoner, the most famous political prisoner in the country who's been sentenced to a almost 14-year jail sentence.
sentences.zh: 他是莱奥波尔多·洛佩斯，一名政治犯，也是该国最著名的政治犯，他被判处了近14年的监禁。

sentences.en: But he's not in his house arreSt. He's behind Juan Guaido.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有在软禁中，他站在胡安·瓜伊多身后。

sentences.en: He's with these military men.
sentences.zh: 他与这些军人在一起。

sentences.en: And all of them are saying, the time has come.
sentences.zh: 他们都在说，时机已到。

sentences.en: This is the juncture.
sentences.zh: 这就是关键时刻。

sentences.en: Get ready.
sentences.zh: 准备好了。

sentences.en: He's been asking for the military to get on his side to push Maduro out for months at this point.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，他已经要求军方站在他这一边把马杜罗赶下台好几个月了。

sentences.en: But there are now military that are behind him.
sentences.zh: 但现在确实有军人站在他身后。

sentences.en: And it looks like they're on his side.
sentences.zh: 看起来他们站在他这一边。

sentences.en: His message now is we've got these guys here.
sentences.zh: 他现在的口信是：我们已经有这些人了。

sentences.en: There's a few of you left.
sentences.zh: 你们剩下的人不多了。

sentences.en: Get on our side.
sentences.zh: 站到我们这边来。

sentences.en: We're going to do all this today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天就要完成这一切。

sentences.en: And, you know, potentially, it sounds like by the end of the day, Maduro is not going to be in power.
sentences.zh: 你知道，听起来可能到今天结束时，马杜罗就不会再掌权了。

sentences.en: Nick, what does this scene signal to you?
sentences.zh: 尼克，这个场景向你传递了什么信号？

sentences.en: Well, it seems there's just suddenly a big blast of hope for the opposition that has been looking
sentences.zh: 嗯，反对派似乎突然燃起了一股巨大的希望，他们一直在

sentences.en: for some moment like this to say that they're going to get the upper hand in this months-long battle against Maduro.
sentences.zh: 寻找这样的时刻，以宣称在这场与马杜罗长达数月的斗争中占据上风。

sentences.en: And this is also ricocheting out to Washington.
sentences.zh: 这也在华盛顿引起了反响。

sentences.en: We see this now as a potentially dispositive moment in the efforts of the Venezuelan people to regain their freedom, which we fully support.
sentences.zh: 我们现在认为，这是委内瑞拉人民重获自由努力中的一个决定性时刻，我们对此完全支持。

sentences.en: I got a call really early in the morning from someone over there saying that they had heard
sentences.zh: 我清晨接到那边某人的电话，说他们听说

sentences.en: the Supreme Court justice was going to sign a memo saying that Guaido was the president and the defense minister was going to suddenly defect from Maduro.
sentences.zh: 最高法院法官将签署一份备忘录，宣布瓜伊多为总统，而国防部长将突然背离马杜罗。

sentences.en: And then also there's these rumors starting to circulate around D.C.
sentences.zh: 而且华盛顿也开始流传谣言，

sentences.en: that Maduro is ginning up a jet to get out of the country.
sentences.zh: 说马杜罗正在准备一架飞机准备逃离该国。

sentences.en: Well, Lauren, Calvin, we are just now learning that Secretary of State Mike Pompeo says he believed early this morning that Nicolas Maduro was actually ready to flee Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 劳伦、卡尔文，我们刚刚获悉，国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥表示，他相信今天清晨尼古拉斯·马杜罗确实准备逃离委内瑞拉。

sentences.en: He had a plane ready on the tarmac.
sentences.zh: 他已经在停机坪上准备好了一架飞机。

sentences.en: Apparently, he was headed to Havana, Cuba.
sentences.zh: 显然，他当时打算前往古巴哈瓦那。

sentences.en: But Mike Pompeo is telling us that he believes the Russians talked him out of it also.
sentences.zh: 但迈克·蓬佩奥告诉我们，他认为是俄罗斯人劝阻了他。

sentences.en: So I'm looking at this still on my bed at this point, and it all looks a little too good to be true for the opposition.
sentences.zh: 当时我还在床上看着这一切，对反对派来说，这一切看起来好得有点不真实。

sentences.en: The people they're talking about defecting have been loyalists for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他们谈论的那些倒戈的人长期以来一直是忠诚派。

sentences.en: And if you look closely at this video, you can't even see how many soldiers are actually standing behind him.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细看这段视频，甚至看不出他身后到底站了多少士兵。

sentences.en: There's no one from the top ranks of the military that's there.
sentences.zh: 军方高层没有人出现在那里。

sentences.en: So what's clear is it's going to be a long day, but it's not clear who's going to be the victor.
sentences.zh: 所以显而易见，这将是漫长的一天，但不清楚谁会成为赢家。

sentences.en: So what actually happens?
sentences.zh: 那么实际上发生了什么？

sentences.en: So people start to gather.
sentences.zh: 人们开始聚集。

sentences.en: They come out for Guaido's call.
sentences.zh: 他们响应了瓜伊多的号召。

sentences.en: They come out to the military base where he's at, and someone opens the door and people start to trickle in.
sentences.zh: 他们来到他所在的军事基地，有人打开了大门，人们开始陆续涌入。

sentences.en: Leopoldo Lopez is standing next to a machine gun.
sentences.zh: 莱奥波尔多·洛佩斯站在一挺机枪旁。

sentences.en: Looks like he's ready to do battle.
sentences.zh: 看起来他准备好战斗了。

sentences.en: There are people in the streets, now large groups of people in Altamira, which is the main opposition neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 街上有人了，现在在主要反对派社区阿尔塔米拉有大群的人。

sentences.en: They start to clash with the military that have been sent out.
sentences.zh: 他们开始与被派来的军队发生冲突。

sentences.en: There's this scene that starts circulating on social media of an armored vehicle that's running over the protesters.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体上开始流传一个场景，一辆装甲车碾压了抗议者。

sentences.en: Suddenly waves of people are coming into the hospitals with these injuries from rubber bullets, from getting hit by the vehicles that are being sent after them.
sentences.zh: 突然间，成群的人因为橡皮子弹的伤害，以及被派去对付他们的车辆撞伤，涌入医院。

sentences.en: Caracas turns into pandemonium for a number of hours.
sentences.zh: 加拉加斯陷入了数小时的混乱。

sentences.en: While this question of who is going to take the countries is getting decided.
sentences.zh: 当关于谁将接管国家的疑问还在争论时。

sentences.en: As this happens, the people who were mentioned to me as the defectors start to get onto Twitter and say they're on Maduro's side.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，那些被提到会倒戈的人开始在推特上说他们站在马杜罗一边。

sentences.en: So it looks like things aren't going well for Guaido.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来瓜伊多的情况不太妙。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Later in the afternoon, news comes out that Leopoldo Lopez, that had gotten out of his house arrest, is now hiding in an embassy.
sentences.zh: 当天下午晚些时候，有消息传出，解除了软禁的莱奥波尔多·洛佩斯现在躲在一家大使馆里。

sentences.en: That doesn't look good.
sentences.zh: 这看起来不妙。

sentences.en: And by evening, by nightfall, it looks like there's just been another battle in this long war that Maduro again has won.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚，夜幕降临，看起来这只是这场漫长战争中的又一场战斗，马杜罗再次获胜。

sentences.en: He's clearly the president.
sentences.zh: 他显然还是总统。

sentences.en: He's clearly in charge of the state.
sentences.zh: 他显然掌控着国家。

sentences.en: And Guaido is back to where he was to begin with, which is the leader of the opposition that's saying he's the president, but isn't.
sentences.zh: 而瓜伊多又回到了最初的状态，即反对派领导人，虽然自称是总统，但实际上并不是。

sentences.en: So by the end of the day, the forces around Guaido have been clearly defeated.
sentences.zh: 所以到一天结束时，瓜伊多周围的势力显然已经被击败了。

sentences.en: And his close ally, Leo Lopez, is literally in hiding.
sentences.zh: 而他的亲密盟友莱奥·洛佩斯正躲藏起来。

sentences.en: It's one giant revolution that starts back to where it began.
sentences.zh: 这是一场巨大的革命，又回到了原点。

sentences.en: One big circle.
sentences.zh: 一个大圆圈。

sentences.en: So it feels like this has been the story of the past few months, that the opposition movement that Juan Guaido is leading gains momentum.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉这就像过去几个月的故事，胡安·瓜伊多领导的反对派运动获得了动力。

sentences.en: It seems like the military might flip against Maduro and he might be ousted.
sentences.zh: 看起来军方可能会倒戈反对马杜罗，他可能会被赶下台。

sentences.en: And yet the military ends up staying with him and he remains in power and the opposition's momentum kind of fizzles.
sentences.zh: 然而军方最终还是留在他身边，他继续掌权，反对派的势头也随之消散了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The cycle has repeated itself so many times.
sentences.zh: 这个循环已经重复了太多次。

sentences.en: The opposition keeps trying to get the
sentences.zh: 反对派一直在试图争取

sentences.en: Venezuelan deep state, which is all of these people from the security establishment to the armed forces, the ones that are really holding up Maduro at this point.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉的“深层政府”，也就是所有这些来自安全机构到武装部队的人，他们是目前真正支撑马杜罗的人。

sentences.en: And they never seem to be able to get that.
sentences.zh: 但他们似乎永远无法做到这一点。

sentences.en: What you see in Venezuela is that it's having to use the deep state to run the state because it's no longer a democracy.
sentences.zh: 你在委内瑞拉看到的是，它必须利用深层政府来管理国家，因为它不再是一个民主国家。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, yeah, it looks like this was just another one of these failed attempts from the opposition to try to be able to get the deep state on their side.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，是的，这看起来只是反对派试图争取深层政府支持的又一次失败尝试。

sentences.en: They haven't been able to get the military to join them fully.
sentences.zh: 他们没能让军方完全加入他们。

sentences.en: They haven't been able to get the secret police to get on their side.
sentences.zh: 他们没能让秘密警察站在他们这一边。

sentences.en: They haven't been able to get these people that are actually the ones in control of the country to join the opposition.
sentences.zh: 他们没能让这些真正控制国家的人加入反对派。

sentences.en: At least it doesn't appear that they have.
sentences.zh: 至少看起来他们没有做到。

sentences.en: But on my desk that day is a dossier and it tells maybe a different story of kinds of fractures that you can't see that are playing out within Mr. Maduro's government.
sentences.zh: 但那天在我的办公桌上有一份档案，它讲述了一个可能不同的故事，关于马杜罗先生政府内部正在发生的你看不见的裂痕。

sentences.en: And what is this dossier?
sentences.zh: 这份档案是什么？

sentences.en: It's a stack of documents that tells a history of a man named Tarek El-Isamy, who's one of the most central people to the government right now after Mr. Maduro.
sentences.zh: 这是一叠文件，讲述了一个名叫塔雷克·埃尔·艾萨米的男人的历史，他是马杜罗先生之后目前政府中最核心的人物之一。

sentences.en: He's one of his chief confidants.
sentences.zh: 他是他最亲信的人之一。

sentences.en: He's a person that you see almost every time that Maduro is going out onto a stage.
sentences.zh: 每当马杜罗走上舞台时，你几乎都能看到他。

sentences.en: He used to be the vice president.
sentences.zh: 他曾担任副总统。

sentences.en: He's one of the most powerful men in the country.
sentences.zh: 他是该国最有权势的人之一。

sentences.en: And what does this stack of documents tell you about him?
sentences.zh: 这叠文件关于他说了些什么？

sentences.en: It says that somebody in the intelligence agency was trying to investigate this man.
sentences.zh: 它说情报机构里的某个人试图调查这个人。

sentences.en: And they had a lot of suspicions, not just of him, but also of his family, having been involved in everything from bringing in militants into the country from the
sentences.zh: 他们不仅对他，而且对他的家人也有很多怀疑，认为他们参与了从将武装分子从

sentences.en: Middle East to trafficking drugs within his own country.
sentences.zh: 中东带入该国，到在该国境内贩毒的一切活动。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So for example, halfway into this dossier, you start to come across documents from the attorney general's office talking about what
sentences.zh: 例如，在这份档案读到一半时，你开始看到来自总检察长办公室的文件，谈论的是

sentences.en: looks like a major drug bust that took place on the border of Brazil and Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 发生在巴西和委内瑞拉边境的一起重大毒品查获案件。

sentences.en: The agents came to these empty warehouses or warehouses they thought were empty, and they suddenly came across 140 tons of
sentences.zh: 特工们来到这些空仓库，或者他们认为空着的仓库，突然发现了140吨

sentences.en: urea, which is one of the components that you use to make cocaine.
sentences.zh: 尿素，这是制造可卡因的成分之一。

sentences.en: Turned out these actually belong to one of the biggest drug traffickers in the country.
sentences.zh: 结果发现这些实际上属于该国最大的毒贩之一。

sentences.en: But the man who came out in these documents as the legal representative of that drug trafficker was Tarek El-Isamy's cousin.
sentences.zh: 但在这些文件中作为该毒贩法律代表出现的人，是塔雷克·埃尔·艾萨米的表弟。

sentences.en: As the case works its way up through the courts, Tarek El-Isamy's star is starting to rise in leftist politics.
sentences.zh: 随着案件在法院的审理，塔雷克·埃尔·艾萨米在左翼政治中的地位开始上升。

sentences.en: And what you see in the dossier is that ultimately the cocaine ingredients are returned back to the drug trafficker.
sentences.zh: 你在档案中看到的是，最终可卡因的成分被退还给了毒贩。

sentences.en: And the implication is this had something to do with Tarek El-Isamy.
sentences.zh: 暗示这与塔雷克·埃尔·艾萨米有关。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But why is this significant right now in the context of all of this political turmoil going on in Venezuela?
sentences.zh: 但为什么这在委内瑞拉当前所有政治动荡的背景下如此重要？

sentences.en: This gets to the core, I think, at what makes Venezuelans angriest the moSt. It's not just that you don't have food in
sentences.zh: 我认为这触及了委内瑞拉人最愤怒的核心。不仅仅是因为你在

sentences.en: Caracas, you don't have medicine or water or electricity.
sentences.zh: 加拉加斯没有食物，没有药品、水或电力。

sentences.en: It's the fact that the government may be the source of your woes because of the level of corruption and how much they've pillaged from the state.
sentences.zh: 而是因为政府可能是你苦难的根源，因为腐败程度以及他们从国家掠夺了多少财富。

sentences.en: While you're starving, someone else is a billionaire and they may have made that money off of drug trafficking.
sentences.zh: 当你挨饿时，别人却是亿万富翁，而他们可能就是靠贩毒赚的钱。

sentences.en: There used to be a term still used called boligarchs, which refers to the people that had benefited from the Bolivarian revolution, the left-wing revolution that took
